headlines.headline: Moody's Ratings Affirms WellSpan Health's Aa3 Bond Rating
headlines.summary: Moody's Ratings has affirmed the Aa3 bond rating for WellSpan Health, maintaining a stable outlook for the integrated health system.

headlines.headline: Goldman Sachs Upgrades United Natural Foods to Buy
headlines.summary: Goldman Sachs has upgraded United Natural Foods, Inc. (UNFI) from Neutral to Buy, setting a price target of $60.

headlines.headline: Stifel Initiates Coverage of The Kroger Co. with Buy Rating
headlines.summary: Stifel has initiated coverage on The Kroger Co. with a 'Buy' rating and a price target of $80.

headlines.headline: US Justice Department to Review DoorDash's Acquisition of Instacart
headlines.summary: The US Justice Department is initiating an antitrust review of DoorDash's planned $17 billion acquisition of Instacart.

headlines.headline: Walmart China Signs Strategic Cooperation Agreement for 15th Five-Year Plan
headlines.summary: Walmart (China) Investment Co. has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with a provincial government to support trade and investment goals through 2030.

headlines.headline: Autodesk and Neilsoft Announce Strategic Partnership for New Centre of Excellence in India
headlines.summary: Autodesk and Neilsoft Limited have partnered to launch a Centre of Excellence (COE) in Pune, India, focused on advancing BIM and Digital Twin technologies for the AECO industry.

headlines.headline: Apple Faces French Trial Over Alleged Planned Obsolescence
headlines.summary: Apple is reportedly facing a trial in France regarding allegations of planned obsolescence concerning its iPhone devices.

headlines.headline: EXL Recognized as a "Horizon 3" Provider in HFS Research Customer Experience Report
headlines.summary: EXL has been named a "Horizon 3" provider in the HFS Research Horizons Customer Experience Service Providers 2026 report, the highest distinction in the assessment.

headlines.headline: Sally Beauty Holdings to Participate in New York Stock Exchange Closing Bell Ring
headlines.summary: Sally Beauty Holdings is scheduled to participate in the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) closing bell ceremony to commemorate the 20th anniversary of its public listing.

headlines.headline: Moody's Corporation Appoints New Chief Information Officer
headlines.summary: Moody's Corporation has announced the appointment of a new Chief Information Officer.

headlines.headline: Cheniere Energy Announces Promotion of Zach Davis to President and Chief Financial Officer
headlines.summary: Cheniere Energy, Inc. has promoted Zach Davis to the roles of President and Chief Financial Officer.

headlines.headline: Tahari Parfums Launches Holiday Fragrance Gift Sets at Walmart
headlines.summary: Horizon Beauty Group has launched two new Tahari Parfums holiday fragrance gift sets, Everbloom and Nightfall, at Walmart stores and online.

headlines.headline: Once Upon a Coconut Expands Nationwide at Walmart
headlines.summary: Premium coconut water brand Once Upon a Coconut has launched in over 4,500 Walmart stores nationwide, including cold grab-and-go placement in 1,500 locations.

headlines.headline: Apple Releases iOS 27.3 Developer Beta Featuring 'Face Unlock' for iPhone Duo
headlines.summary: Apple's latest iOS 27.3 developer beta introduces a new software-based 'face unlock' feature specifically for the iPhone Duo.

headlines.headline: Apple Appoints 26-Year Veteran Corey Fugman to Lead Payments and Wallet Unit
headlines.summary: Apple has named company veteran Corey Fugman to head its payments and digital wallet division, which oversees Apple Pay, Apple Card, and Wallet services.

headlines.headline: Moody's Ratings Downgrades Volvo Cars to Ba2
headlines.summary: Moody's Ratings has downgraded the corporate family rating of Volvo Car AB to Ba2, maintaining a negative outlook.

headlines.headline: Moody's Analytics Lowers 2026 Philippines Growth Forecast
headlines.summary: Moody's Analytics has revised its 2026 economic growth forecast for the Philippines downward to 2.4 percent, citing weak domestic demand.

headlines.headline: Brian Josephs Promoted to Senior Live Editor at The New York Times
headlines.summary: The New York Times has promoted Brian Josephs to the role of senior live editor based in New York.

headlines.headline: Jeremy Peters Appointed as The New York Times South Asia Bureau Chief
headlines.summary: The New York Times has appointed veteran political reporter Jeremy Peters as its new South Asia bureau chief based in New Delhi.

headlines.headline: Best Buy Joins Circana's Collaborative Retail Program
headlines.summary: Best Buy has joined Circana's collaborative retail program to provide suppliers with enhanced access to first-party data and AI-powered analytics.

headlines.headline: Apple and OpenEvidence Launch Virtual Health AI Research Study
headlines.summary: Apple has initiated a virtual research study in collaboration with OpenEvidence to investigate how consumers utilize conversational artificial intelligence for health-related purposes.

headlines.headline: Monotype Launches Brand Font Panel for Adobe Creative Apps
headlines.summary: Monotype has released the Monotype Connect panel for Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign, enabling teams to access approved brand fonts directly within their design workflows.

headlines.headline: ExlService Holdings, Inc. Director Sells $4.32 Million in Shares
headlines.summary: A director at ExlService Holdings, Inc. sold 100,000 shares of common stock valued at approximately $4.32 million, according to a recent SEC filing.

headlines.headline: Edible Garden AG Incorporated Reports Q3 2026 Results and Retail Distribution Expansion
headlines.summary: Edible Garden AG Incorporated announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, noting that its retail distribution network has been strengthened by new awards from Walmart distribution centers and expansion with UNFI in the Mid-Atlantic region.

headlines.headline: Moody's Ratings Issues Multiple Rating Actions on November 16, 2026
headlines.summary: Moody's Ratings announced several credit rating actions, including outlook changes, provisional ratings, and upgrades for various corporate and structured finance entities.

headlines.headline: Dropbox Updates Inactive Account Policy Effective January 2027
headlines.summary: Dropbox has announced a policy change that will accelerate the deletion of inactive user accounts starting in January 2027.

headlines.headline: VeriSign to Go Ex-Dividend on November 17, 2026
headlines.summary: VeriSign, Inc. is scheduled to go ex-dividend on November 17, 2026, with a dividend payment of $0.81 per share.

headlines.headline: Walmart Appoints Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed to Board of Directors
headlines.summary: Walmart Inc. has appointed Joseph E. Creed, the chairman and CEO of Caterpillar Inc., to its board of directors, effective immediately.

headlines.headline: RBC Lowers Price Target on CVS Health
headlines.summary: RBC Capital Markets has adjusted its price target for CVS Health Corporation, lowering it from $113 to $108 while maintaining an Outperform rating.

headlines.headline: Best Buy Canada Partners with Uber Eats for On-Demand Delivery
headlines.summary: Best Buy Co., Inc. and Uber Technologies, Inc. have launched a partnership to offer on-demand delivery of electronics from nearly 300 Best Buy Canada locations via the Uber Eats app.

headlines.headline: Telsey Advisory Group Adjusts Best Buy Price Target
headlines.summary: Telsey Advisory Group has increased its price target for Best Buy Co., Inc. from $95 to $110.

headlines.headline: Walmart and Operation Homefront Partner for Holiday Support
headlines.summary: Walmart is collaborating with Operation Homefront for the fourth consecutive year to provide support to military and veteran families during the holiday season.

headlines.headline: Domino's Launches New 'Sweet Heat Smokehouse' Specialty Pizza
headlines.summary: Domino's Pizza, Inc. has introduced a new specialty pizza, the Sweet Heat Smokehouse, available at stores nationwide starting November 16, 2026.

headlines.headline: Adobe Highlights C2PA Standards at Adobe MAX 2026
headlines.summary: At the Adobe MAX 2026 conference, Adobe emphasized the role of the C2PA standard in distinguishing AI-generated content and providing provenance information.

headlines.headline: KakaoBank Launches Apple Pay in South Korea
headlines.summary: KakaoBank has officially launched Apple Pay, allowing its customers to add their cards to Apple Wallet for digital payments.

headlines.headline: BNP Paribas Adjusts Price Target on Walmart to $144 From $137
headlines.summary: BNP Paribas has updated its price target for Walmart Inc. (WMT), raising it from $137 to $144.

headlines.headline: CVS Health Releases Research on GLP-1 Benefits and Affordability
headlines.summary: CVS Health published new research analyzing the clinical and economic impact of GLP-1 medications using real-world Aetna claims data.

headlines.headline: Moody's Affirms Willis Towers Watson Ratings
headlines.summary: Moody's has affirmed the credit ratings of Willis Towers Watson, highlighting the company's diversified client base and market position.

headlines.headline: Basic Support for Apple M5 SoC Expected in Linux 7.5 Kernel
headlines.summary: Initial support for Apple's M5 system-on-a-chip has been queued for the upcoming Linux 7.5 kernel release.

note: next_earnings_estimate is last year's results date + 364 days, not a confirmed date. 8-K items: 2.02 results, 5.02 officer changes, 1.01 material agreements, 4.01 auditor change, 4.02 non-reliance on prior financials.
